smi_2026.label: Salario Minimo Interprofesional (SMI) 2026
smi_2026.value: 1,221 EUR/month in 14 payments (17,094 EUR/year); daily rate 40.70 EUR
smi_2026.source_name: Real Decreto 126/2026, de 18 de febrero, por el que se fija el salario minimo interprofesional para 2026 (BOE-A-2026-3815)

irpf_state_scale_2026.label: IRPF escala general estatal, 2026
irpf_state_scale_2026.source_name: Agencia Tributaria (confirmed unchanged from 2025 scale; no Ley de Presupuestos 2026 amendment to the state scale identified)

irpf_regional_scales_2025_16_regions.label: IRPF escalas autonomicas, 16 comunidades (2025 scales, current through the 2026 filing campaign)
irpf_regional_scales_2025_16_regions.value: Full bracket tables and each region's own minimo del contribuyente (which can differ from the EUR 5,550 state figure, e.g. Madrid EUR 5,956.65) for Madrid, Andalucia, Aragon, Asturias, Baleares, Canarias, Cantabria, Castilla-La Mancha, Castilla y Leon, Cataluna, Extremadura, Galicia, Murcia, La Rioja, Comunidad Valenciana, and the Ceuta/Melilla special scale (Art. 65 LIRPF) -- see docs/data/spain/spain_parameters_2026.json 'regions' for the full per-region data and per-region source citations (each individually verified against the official AEAT per-region page)
irpf_regional_scales_2025_16_regions.source_name: Agencia Tributaria (AEAT), Manual Practico de Renta 2025, per-region 'gravamen autonomico' pages
irpf_regional_scales_2025_16_regions.note: No comunidad autonoma has yet legislated a scale specifically for tax-year-2026 income at the time of writing; the 2025 scale (filed in the 2026 campaign) is the current, effective figure for every region, mirroring how the existing Madrid bracket set (legislated in 2023) remains current. Navarra and Pais Vasco are excluded: separate 'foral' tax systems (Concierto/Convenio economico), out of scope for this module.

irpf_personal_minimum_and_work_income_re.label: Minimo del contribuyente estatal (soltero, sin hijos) and reduccion por obtencion de rendimientos del trabajo (Art. 20 LIRPF), 2026
irpf_personal_minimum_and_work_income_re.value: State personal minimum EUR 5,550/year (applies to the state portion of the tax in every region); work-income reduction EUR 7,302 if net work income <= EUR 14,852, tapering linearly to EUR 2,364.34 at EUR 17,673.52, then to EUR 0 at EUR 19,747.50 and above
irpf_personal_minimum_and_work_income_re.source_name: Ley 35/2006 del IRPF, articulos 20 y 57 (unchanged figures carried into 2026), cross-checked against Agencia Tributaria practical guidance
irpf_personal_minimum_and_work_income_re.note: Each region additionally sets its OWN minimo del contribuyente for the regional portion of the tax only (see 'irpf_regional_scales_2025_16_regions'); this state figure applies only to the state portion, in every region.

seguridad_social_regimen_general_2026.label: Cotizaciones a la Seguridad Social, Regimen General, contrato indefinido, 2026
seguridad_social_regimen_general_2026.value: Employee 6.50% (contingencias comunes 4.70%, desempleo 1.55%, MEI 0.15%, formacion profesional 0.10%); employer 31.65% (contingencias comunes 23.60%, desempleo 5.50%, MEI 0.75%, formacion profesional 0.60%, FOGASA 0.20%, AT/EP 1.00% assumed standard low-risk rate); base minima EUR 1,424.40/month, base maxima EUR 5,101.20/month
seguridad_social_regimen_general_2026.source_name: Tesoreria General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS), bases y tipos de cotizacion 2026
seguridad_social_regimen_general_2026.note: The AT/EP (accidentes de trabajo y enfermedades profesionales) rate varies by CNAE activity code under the official tariff (Real Decreto 2930/1979 as updated); this module assumes a flat 1.00% standard low-risk rate, as no single verbatim 2026 rate applies economy-wide. All other Seguridad Social rates and the contribution base floor/ceiling are high confidence.

ine_ccaa_population_2025.source_name: INE (Instituto Nacional de Estadistica), Cifras oficiales de poblacion
